parts.name: T-505 (new try)
parts.text: Presumption is a powerful thing (a presupposition hides an assumption inside a sentence, and the person hearing it usually takes that assumption on board), so please don’t use it except to presume that we will have the choice of when it will happen, that we will be able to do it, that we are safe, that we are loved and that our adult can lead us. Don’t ever presume obedience, the way a hypnotist does when they say something like, ‘As you go deeper, it gets easier and easier to just do what I say.’
parts.why: my fix of 30 October (F14.4); read AI (Medium and Low), part B windows 9 and 11 last time

parts.name: T-508 (new try)
parts.text: Bridge words are words like ‘as, whilst, because, when, after, before, which means’ etc. These are words that link events. However, even if you say them in a lovely gentle voice it doesn’t mean that it’s true if it isn’t! It’s not very likely that just by breathing in and out your trauma is going to go away! So an honest bridge might sound more like, ‘As I breathe, my adult self may become present enough to hear a little of what the wound needs.’
